Hi team,

Upon checking, the deploys that failed shows installation of the netlify-gatsby plugin @netlify/plugin-gatsby@3.8.3 (latest version). It seems Netlify added this by default when no custom configuration was found (netlify.toml) and the issues are caused by package incompatibilities. Not sure why that happens when we had last successful build at April 1.

The Gatsby version used by this project is at 2.19.8 based from the package.json file. Based on this info I've found, Gatsby v2 below are only compatible with v1 of @netlify/plugin-gatsby and node version 18/20.

To resolve the issue we did the following steps:

1. Update the Node dependency for the project to use v20
https://app.netlify.com/sites/fabricatingequipmentsales-sdd/configuration/deploys#dependency-management

2. Install the netlify-gatsby v1 plugin to the devDependencies
npm install -D @netlify/plugin-gatsby@1.0.3

3. Add a netlify.toml file to the project

4. On the netlify.toml file, add the following lines so our Netlify builds would get the package version we installed
[[plugins]]
package = "@netlify/plugin-gatsby"

4. Commit changes from step 2-4 to the master branch to trigger redeploy

Confirmed project now builds successfully
